title: ICA-UAP-D001, Analysis: Colorado Springs UAP Incident, 2022
doc_notes: This document is an analysis by an AARO Intelligence Community partner regarding a 2022 UAP sighting near Cheyenne Mountain, Colorado.

incidents.summary: Five U.S. Army service members observed an airborne object over Cheyenne Mountain that appeared as an angular, non-symmetrical potato.
incidents.explanation: Possibly backscattering of sunlight reflecting off snow-covered ground onto low-level clouds.
incidents.quote: resembling an angular, non-symmetrical potato made of uneven panels
